node.statement: Dependency bridge and defect estimate. Require nodes 1.2 and 1.3.1 to be validated. Thus, uniformly in n, gamma_n has involution and multiplicative defects at most K_hom e and satisfies c_0 <= a_n <= b_n <= 5. For X, insert gamma_n(X^dagger)gamma_n(X) between gamma_n(X^dagger X) and gamma_n(X)^dagger gamma_n(X). The target product-norm axiom yields an error at most K_hom e[1+(1+epsilon)b_n]||X||^2. Under e<=1 (so epsilon<=1) and b_n<=5 this is at most D e||X||^2 with the universal choice D=11K_hom.
